info.title: Anakin API
info.description: Web scraping (url-scraper, map, crawl), AI search (search, agentic-search), the Wire pre-built-automation catalog (resolve, catalog, task execution, identities, login, build-request), website change monitoring, AI-visibility (multi-engine answer comparison), saved browser sessions, and AI browser automation. Full 21-operation surface consumed by anakin-mcp (see https://github.com/anakin-io/anakin-mcp/blob/main/src/client.ts), the ground truth this document is generated from. See https://docs.anakin.io for authoritative API docs.

useBrowser.description: Render with a headless browser instead of a plain HTTP fetch.

generateJson.description: Ask the model to also emit a structured JSON extraction of the page.

forceFresh.description: Bypass the response cache and force a fresh scrape.

sessionId.description: Reuse an existing authenticated browser session (see /sessions).

sessionName.description: Human-readable name for a new session created for this scrape.

jobId.description: Job id to poll for the result.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

useBrowser.description: Allow the agent to use a headless browser for pages that need it.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the structured data to extract.

url.description: The starting URL for discovery (typically a homepage or section root).

limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to return overall.

depth.description: How many link-hops from the starting URL to follow.

limitPerLevel.description: Maximum URLs collected per depth level (controls breadth).

includeSubdomains.description: Include URLs on subdomains of the starting host.

includeExternalLinks.description: Also collect (but do not follow) external links.

useBrowser.description: Render with a headless browser (for SPAs).

search.description: Optional keyword filter — only return URLs whose path/title matches.

depth.description: Link-hops from the starting URL to follow.

useBrowser.description: Render each page in a headless browser (for SPAs).

includePatterns.description: Glob/regex patterns. Only URLs matching at least one pattern are fetched.

excludePatterns.description: Glob/regex patterns. URLs matching any pattern are skipped.

sessionId.description: Reuse an existing authenticated browser session (see /sessions).

sessionName.description: Human-readable name for a new session created for this crawl.

WireResolveResponse.description: Ranked candidate Wire actions for a natural-language intent.

results.description: Each item carries at least action_id, type (read/write), a params schema, credit cost, and auth_mode.

WireCatalogResponse.description: With no slug: every supported website and its action count. With a slug: that site's full action list, parameter schemas, auth modes, and credit costs. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

action_id.description: The Wire action to run (from GET /wire/resolve or /wire/catalog).

params.description: The action's input parameters. Shape depends on the action. Omitted for actions that take none.

credential_id.description: Required when the action's auth_mode is "required"; honored when "optional".

identity_id.description: Optional identity selector — the server resolves a credential from it (alternative to credential_id).

WireTaskResponse.description: Either an accepted-job envelope (status/job_id/poll_url — poll GET /wire/jobs/{job_id}) or, for sync actions, the terminal result inline (data/credits_used/execution_ms) with no job_id.

job_id.description: Present when the task runs asynchronously — poll GET /wire/jobs/{jobId}.

data.description: Present when the action completed synchronously inline.

connect_url.description: Present on AUTH_REQUIRED — where to connect the account.

retry_after_ms.description: Present while processing — the server's suggested poll delay.

data.description: Present when completed — the action's extracted/returned data.

WireIdentitiesResponse.description: Saved identities and their credentials (id, catalog, status). Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

catalog_slug.description: The catalog to sign in to (e.g. "neb").

identity_name.description: Optional name for the identity. Derived from params in password mode; required when using a 1Password locator.

params.description: Login fields defined by the catalog (e.g. { email, password }).

source_ref.description: Optional 1Password item locator { vault_id, item_id, fields } (use with source_id instead of params).

WireLoginResponse.description: A credential_id usable immediately with POST /wire/task. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

website_url.description: The site to build an action for. The domain is extracted automatically.

goal.description: Natural-language description of what the action should do or extract.

catalog_id.description: Optional — attach to an existing catalog instead of creating one.

force.description: Build even if similar actions already exist for the domain (otherwise the request is rejected with ACTION_EXISTS).

WireBuildResponse.description: Async build status (starts "pending"). Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

url.description: The URL to watch (root URL for site scope; the Wire site's URL for wire scope).

scope.description: What to monitor: one page (default), a whole site, or a Wire action.

watchMode.description: Compare the whole page (default) or only the fields in outputSchema, extracted with AI.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the fields to track. Required when watchMode is "specific_data".

aiMode.description: AI meaningful-change filtering: ignores trivial noise and summarizes real changes. +1 credit per check.

aiGoal.description: Natural-language description of which changes count as meaningful (used with aiMode).

useBrowser.description: Render checks with a stealth headless browser. Forced true when sessionId is set.

sessionId.description: Saved browser-session ID for monitoring login-protected pages.

expiresAt.description: Optional end date (ISO 8601 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD); the monitor auto-pauses when it passes.

alertWebhookUrl.description: Webhook URL that receives signed change alerts.

alertEmails.description: Comma-separated email recipients for change alerts.

maxPages.description: Site scope: max pages crawled per run.

maxDepth.description: Site scope: crawl depth (1-5). Defaults to 2.

includePatterns.description: Site scope: glob patterns or hand-picked same-site URLs to track.

excludePatterns.description: Site scope: glob patterns to skip.

wireActionId.description: Wire scope (required there): the Wire action run each check, e.g. "amazon.search_products".

wireCatalogSlug.description: Wire scope: catalogue slug of the Wire site.

wireCredentialId.description: Wire scope: credential ID when the action needs auth.

wireParams.description: Wire scope: parameters passed to the action each check.

wireWatchPaths.description: Wire scope: JSON paths to diff instead of the whole response.

MonitorResponse.description: A monitor's configuration and status (id, schedule, active state, alert settings). Includes alertWebhookSecret (an HMAC signing secret) on creation. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns Record<string, unknown>); represented permissively.

MonitorListResponse.description: The caller's monitors. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

MonitorChangesResponse.description: Detected changes for a monitor, each with when the watched content differed and a diff/summary. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

MonitorControlResponse.description: Result of pausing/resuming/running/deleting a monitor. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

query.description: The question to ask every engine.

sources.description: Engine slugs to query (see GET /ai-visibility/sources). Omit to query all enabled engines.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country for the search geography (proxy exit).

status.description: "running" while in progress; terminal states include "completed" and "failed" (open-ended — other values are possible).

results.description: One entry per engine: status, answer summary, latency, credits used, consensus/outlier verdict, and full_content when requested.

synthesis.description: AI-generated synthesis of where the engines agree and diverge.

AIVisibilitySourcesResponse.description: Available AI answer engines, each with a slug and display label. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

SessionsListResponse.description: Saved browser sessions (encrypted login states), each with an id usable as sessionId elsewhere. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

SessionDeleteResponse.description: Confirmation of session deletion. Shape not fully typed in ground truth (client.ts returns `unknown`); represented permissively.

prompt.description: The task in natural language. Never include passwords or secrets — use session_id for authenticated sites.

async.description: Run asynchronously (202 + workflow_id, poll GET /ai/jobs/{id}) instead of blocking. Always sent true — the synchronous variant can block for up to ~5.5 minutes, far past a typical request timeout.

url.description: Navigate here before starting. Omit to let the agent follow URLs named in the prompt.

session_id.description: Saved browser-session ID so the task runs logged in.

timeout_ms.description: Task timeout in milliseconds (server caps runs at ~330s regardless).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the result — the agent returns structured data conforming to it.

workflow_id.description: Present in async mode — poll GET /ai/jobs/{workflow_id}.

result.description: The task's output — structured JSON when output_schema was supplied.

post.description: Async job — submit here, then poll GET /url-scraper/{jobId} until status is completed or failed.

200.description: Current job state. Terminal when status is completed or failed.

post.description: Synchronous — returns directly, no polling. Costs 3 credits per call.

post.summary: Submit a multi-stage agentic research job
post.description: Async job — submit here, then poll GET /agentic-search/{jobId} until status is completed or failed. Costs 10 credits.

200.description: Current job state. Terminal when status is completed or failed.

post.description: Async job — submit here, then poll GET /map/{jobId} until status is completed or failed. Discovers reachable URLs under a site (internal + external links) without fetching page content.

200.description: Current job state. Terminal when status is completed or failed.

post.description: Async job — submit here, then poll GET /crawl/{jobId} until status is completed or failed. Bulk-fetches markdown/HTML across a site, scoped by maxPages/depth/includePatterns/excludePatterns.

200.description: Current job state. Terminal when status is completed or failed.

get.summary: Find Wire actions for a natural-language intent
get.description: Synchronous — returns ranked candidate actions directly, no polling. Wire is a catalog of pre-built automation actions across hundreds of websites; each result carries its action_id, type (read/write), parameter schema, credit cost, and auth requirement. Run a returned action with POST /wire/task.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The intent in natural language, e.g. "top phones on walmart".

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidate actions to return.

get.description: Synchronous. Every supported website and its action count.

get.summary: Get one Wire catalog's full action list
get.description: Synchronous. That site's full action list with exact parameter schemas, each action's type (read/write), auth mode, and credit cost, plus login fields for credentials-mode sites.

post.summary: Run a Wire action (read or write)
post.description: Submits a Wire action by action_id (from GET /wire/resolve or /wire/catalog). Most actions run async — the response carries a job_id to poll at GET /wire/jobs/{jobId}; some actions complete synchronously and return their data inline instead. Covers both read actions (data extraction, read-only) and write actions (state-changing interactions on the target site) — the action's own `type` (read/write), not this endpoint, determines which. Pass credential_id or identity_id when the action's auth_mode is required.

200.description: Task accepted (async — poll GET /wire/jobs/{job_id}) or completed synchronously with data inline.
Current job state. Terminal when status is completed or failed.

get.summary: List saved Wire identities and credentials
get.description: Synchronous. An identity is a named account on a site; each credential's id is the credential_id passed to POST /wire/task for actions whose auth_mode is required.

parameters.name: catalog_id
parameters.description: Restrict to identities for a single catalog.

post.summary: Sign in to a credentials-mode Wire site
post.description: Synchronous. Returns a credential_id usable immediately with POST /wire/task. The password is never stored, only the encrypted session. Only for catalogs that support password sign-in; cookie-based sites use the dashboard connect flow instead.

post.summary: Request a brand-new Wire action for an uncataloged site
post.description: Asynchronous (returns status "pending") and charges credits, refunded automatically if the build fails. Only use after GET /wire/resolve / /wire/catalog confirm no existing action covers the site.

Checks a URL every intervalMinutes (min 15) and records a change when the content differs — optionally alerting a webhook or email. scope "page" (default) watches one URL; "site" crawls the site each run; "wire" runs a Wire action each check and diffs its JSON.

get.description: Full configuration and status: next/last check time, active state, per-check credit cost, alert settings.

delete.description: Permanently removes the monitor and its history.

get.description: Each entry records when the watched content differed from the previous check, with a diff/summary (and the AI change summary when aiMode is on).

post.description: Restarts scheduled checks. May hit the plan's active-monitor cap.
Runs an out-of-schedule check now, billed like a normal check.

post.summary: Ask multiple AI answer engines the same question
post.description: Async job — submit here, then poll GET /ai-visibility/search/{searchId} until status is no longer "running". Fans one query out to multiple AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview) and returns one result per engine plus a synthesis. Billed per source; failed sources are free.

200.description: Search submitted (or already resolved for very fast runs).
Current search state. Terminal when status is not "running".

get.description: Each engine's slug (what to pass as `sources`) and display label.
Encrypted login states captured via the Anakin dashboard or Browser API. Each session's id is usable as sessionId in scrape/crawl/map, monitor create, and browser_task.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Filter to sessions for one website domain, e.g. "amazon.com".

delete.description: Permanently deletes the session and its encrypted login data. Irreversible.

post.summary: Run a natural-language AI browser task
post.description: Submitted in async mode (async: true → 202 + workflow_id); poll GET /ai/jobs/{workflow_id}. Drives a real stealth browser (navigate, click, type, extract) to complete the task, optionally returning structured JSON per output_schema. Server hard-caps a run at ~330s.

200.description: Current job state. Terminal when status is completed, failed, or timed_out.
